title: Chirurgie des surfaces conformes : notes manuscrites (s.d., 1983-1984), lettres (1984).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the previous page's set-up. TB_{g,ν} is a 'Teichmüller space with boundary', of real dimension 6g-6+3ν. That is exactly the dimension of the Teichmüller space of hyperbolic surfaces of type (g,ν) with geodesic boundary: Fenchel–Nielsen coordinates (length and twist) on the 3g-3+ν interior curves, plus the ν boundary lengths l_i. Grothendieck writes it as C^{3g-3+ν}×R^ν. There is a map TB_{g,ν} → T_{g,ν} which 'plugs the holes' (bouchage des trous), and he hopes it is simply the canonical projection, i.e. a trivial R^ν-fibration.

On this page he reduces that hope to the pair of pants, type (0,3). Take a bordered sphere Σ* with three holes and boundary parameters l_i (i∈I, |I|=3). One should describe Σ* as a model three-pointed sphere S(I) (P^1 with three marked points) with three disks D(l_i) removed. The key requirement is that each disk D(l_i) depends only on its own parameter l_i and not on the other l_j. The marginal bracket and the 'si ?' show he regards this as unverified and heuristic.

Granting it, he concludes, at least in the oriented hyperbolic case, the following. For a fixed punctured conformal surface (X, a_i) of type (g,ν), the admissible families (D_i) of conformal disks around the punctures a_i (those arising by capping a bordered surface) form a space homeomorphic to R^d, d = card I: '∞^d possible openings'.

He then states a conjecture, completed on the next page. The map (D_i) ↦ (σ(D_i)) is a bijection from admissible systems of conformal disks around the a_i to systems of 'standard' disks in the tangent lines T_{X,a_i}. Here σ(D) is presumably the disk in T_{X,a} determined by the derivative at a of the uniformisation of D onto the unit disk centred at a. Equivalently, σ(D) is a hermitian norm on T_{X,a}, i.e. a point of an R_+^*-torsor.

The next page draws the consequences. TB_{g,I} → T_{g,I} would be a principal (R_+^*)^I-bundle. Canonical sections would give, for every punctured surface, a canonical system of disks, i.e. canonical norms on the tangent lines at the punctures. The problem served is the 'surgery' (chirurgie) or Lego picture of conformal surfaces. The aim is to relate bordered or geodesic-boundary moduli to punctured moduli in a canonical, gluing-compatible way.
errors: The central reduction (disks D(l_i) in the model sphere S(I) depending only on l_i) is unproved, and Grothendieck himself flags it with 'si ?' and a marginal bracket.

There is no obvious canonical choice of disk centres: a sphere minus three disjoint closed disks has 3 real conformal moduli, but choosing the three centres is extra data. Whether a canonical choice with the claimed independence exists is a genuine gap.

'Espace homéomorphe à R^d' for the admissible disk families depends on what 'admissible' means. Without that restriction, the space of conformal disk systems around the punctures is infinite-dimensional.

Whether the capping map is literally the projection C^{3g-3+ν}×R^ν → C^{3g-3+ν} is asserted only as a presumption ('je présume'). Fenchel–Nielsen coordinates are real, so the complex factor C^{3g-3+ν} is only a homeomorphism type, not a canonical complex structure.

ideas.what: Teichmüller space of bordered (geodesic-boundary) surfaces of type (g,ν), of real dimension 6g-6+3ν, fibring over the Teichmüller space of punctured surfaces with fibre R^ν (boundary lengths).
ideas.modern_name: Teichmüller space of hyperbolic surfaces with geodesic boundary; relation to decorated Teichmüller space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Fenchel–Nielsen (coordinates); Penner 1987 (decorated Teichmüller space as trivial R_+^n-bundle); Mondello 2009 (bordered surfaces to cusps)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme alludes to Teichmüller towers and 'Lego' surgery, but not to this fibration explicitly

ideas.what: Capping holes of a pair of pants by disks in a model three-pointed sphere, with each disk depending only on its own boundary parameter.
ideas.modern_name: canonical capping / plumbing of boundary components (pants-level surgery)
ideas.usually_credited_to: unsure (related to plumbing coordinates: Earle–Marden, Wolpert)

ideas.what: Conjecture: admissible disk systems around punctures correspond bijectively to 'standard disks' (norms) in the tangent lines T_{X,a_i}, making TB → T a principal (R_+^*)^I-bundle with canonical sections, hence canonical norms at punctures.
ideas.modern_name: hermitian metrics on the ψ-class (tangent/cotangent) line bundles at punctures; canonical cusp coordinates
ideas.usually_credited_to: Penner (horocycle decorations, 1987); Wolpert, Takhtajan–Zograf (canonical cusp normalisation and metric on ψ-bundles)

missed.claim: Grothendieck (1983-84) identifies the boundary-length fibre of bordered Teichmüller space with the torsor of norms on tangent lines at punctures. That is an (R_+^*)^I principal bundle, and he asks for canonical sections. This anticipates the later link between decorated Teichmüller theory (horocycle decorations) and hermitian metrics on ψ-line bundles. Here it is phrased through conformal disk systems rather than hyperbolic horocycles.
missed.quote: les familles (D_i) (des disques ... autour des a_i) forment un espace homéomorphe à R^d ... Conjecture : ... l'application (D_i) ↦ (σ(D_i)) ...
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It suggests formulating gluing and surgery of conformal surfaces through canonical tangent-line norms. This is close in spirit to the Mondello / Do–Norbury limits from geodesic boundary to cusps and to Segal-type sewing, but it predates them and is phrased in purely conformal terms.

missed.claim: Open question: is there a canonical model of conformal pants as a three-pointed sphere minus disks, where each disk depends only on its own boundary parameter? A positive answer would make plugging holes the trivial projection.
missed.quote: en enlevant des disques ... D(l_i) dont chacun ne dépend pas des l_i correspondants, pas des autres l_j
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Such a canonical capping would give gluing-compatible coordinates for a 'Lego' description of moduli spaces.

deep.surprise_reason: This is an unpublished heuristic conjecture from Grothendieck's surgery programme. It anticipates decorated or bordered Teichmüller fibrations and canonical tangent norms at punctures, but those structures were later developed independently (Penner, Mondello, Takhtajan–Zograf). The page itself is tentative and contains no proof.

'la sphère {+bébé+} S(I) trajectoire' is probably 'la sphère S(I) tripointée' (the three-pointed sphere, type (0,3)).
'par des autres l_j' should be 'pas des autres l_j'.
'(des disques en bonne [?] dans [?]' is likely '(des disques conformes autour des a_i)'.
